title: 10-year Treasury yield hits 19-year high at 5.22%; 30-year at 5.50%
summary: The benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield surged past 5.22% to a level not seen since 2007, while the 30-year reached 5.50%, a high unseen since 2004. The yield rout follows the Fed's Sep 16 quarter-point hike to 3.75%-4% and expectations of at least one more hike this year, with elevated inflation cited. Japan's JGB yield also hit its highest since 1996.
why: 利率长端飙升压制成长股估值，对我们持有的科技/消费组合形成整体压力；隐含波动率随之抬升，sell put策略需上调保证金估算并缩短到期时长。

title: 港股收评：恒指跌1.01% 科指跌1.13% 科网股普跌 石油股走弱
summary: 9月25日香港恒生指数收报24510.09点，跌幅1.01%，跌251.04点，全日主板成交1022.03亿港元；恒生科技指数跌1.13%，科网股普跌，网易跌超3%，小米跌超2%；石油股走弱，中石油跌超2%。
why: 港股科技板块与恒指同步下行，腾讯/阿里/小米等持仓面临短期浮亏压力；成交量维持千亿水平说明市场活跃度未显著萎缩，可留意低位sell put机会。

title: JPMorgan: Meta Muse AI agent has potential to dominate AI space; week-long AI sector rally
summary: JPMorgan issued a bullish view on Meta following Muse's explosive growth—2.5-2.8 million downloads in 12 days, topping the US App Store. Analyst said Muse has the potential to dominate the AI space. Meta stock rallied 16.8% for the week; broader AI sector surged: AMD +10%, Intel +12%, Arm +17%, Qualcomm +9%. S&P 500 ended the week up 0.6% despite bond yield pressure.
why: AI agent产品化加速，整个AI硬件/软件链条的风险偏好显著回升，对我们持有的英伟达、SK海力士、美光等芯片仓位形成提振；同时腾讯/阿里的AI商业化预期也受到催化。

title: Trump-Xi state visit in Washington: first bilateral summit in 11 years; trade, tariffs, AI on agenda
summary: Xi Jinping arrived for a state visit to Washington (Sep 23-25), his first in 11 years. High-stakes bilateral talks covered import tariffs, AI regulation, the Middle East conflict, and China-U.S. economic relations. Markets and analysts watched closely for trade de-escalation signals.
why: 中美元首会晤是港股/A股最重要宏观催化剂之一：若会晤释放贸易缓和信号，中概股及港股科技板块预计受益；关税走向也直接影响拼多多Temu出海逻辑。延续报道：会晤从9月23日持续至25日，成果公报尚未全面发布。

title: Microsoft revamps Copilot as AI super app: Home, Code (app-builder), and Autopilot agent announced
summary: Microsoft announced a major Copilot overhaul (Sep 25): Code lets users build apps and dashboards via natural language; Autopilot is an always-on AI agent evolved from Scout; Home integrates Word, Excel, PowerPoint directly inside Copilot. Code preview rolls out to Microsoft 365 Premium customers end of month. Microsoft rose over 2.5% on the news.
why: 微软AI平台升级加速AI超级App的行业竞争格局，直接催化腾讯/阿里类Agent产品的评估预期；也将抬升AI基础设施（英伟达GPU、SK海力士HBM）的远期需求，对我们半导体持仓偏正面。

title: SK Hynix's Solidigm weighs 2027 US IPO at up to $150B valuation; could raise $15B
summary: SK Hynix held a bank bake-off for its U.S. NAND subsidiary Solidigm, targeting a 2027 U.S. IPO that could value the unit at up to $150 billion and raise ~$15 billion—potentially the largest-ever U.S. semiconductor IPO, topping Arm's $54B debut. Solidigm was carved out from Intel's NAND business acquired for ~$9B in 2021.
why: SK海力士子公司IPO计划利好其整体估值及资产重估预期；NAND存储赛道IPO热度也提升整体半导体板块风险偏好，美光（MU）及英伟达生态间接受益。

title: Alibaba Apsara Conference: Zhenwu V900 AI chip (3x gain), Qwen 4 in training, 8-city datacenter expansion
summary: At the 2026 Apsara Conference (Sep 22-23, Hangzhou), Alibaba unveiled the Zhenwu V900 AI chip—China's most powerful AI chip, delivering 3x the performance of predecessor M890—and confirmed Qwen 4 is in training. Alibaba Cloud also announced its first cloud regions in Turkey, Finland, and the Netherlands, plus expansions in UAE, France, Malaysia, and Germany within 12 months.
why: 阿里自研AI芯片及Qwen 4进入训练直接强化云业务护城河，缓解外部GPU依赖叙事；欧洲/中东数据中心扩张加速国际云营收，对BABA/9988持仓的中长期估值催化明显。延续报道：数据中心扩张为会议次日Bloomberg（9月23日）独立跟进报道。

title: Tencent releases Hy Image 3.5 AI model to challenge ByteDance, Alibaba; shares surge 7%+
summary: Tencent launched Hy Image 3.5 Preview on Sep 22, its latest image-generation model with improved performance over the prior version, integrating into Yuanbao chatbot and design tools. The release—timed to coincide with Alibaba's Apsara Conference—signals Tencent's intent to close the AI image gap with ByteDance and Alibaba. Tencent shares gained more than 7% in Hong Kong amid Muse-driven read-through.
why: 腾讯AI产品矩阵加速填充，Hy Image 3.5+WeChat AI助手Xiaowei测试双管齐下，Meta Muse爆红后市场重新评估WeChat超级App的商业化价值；股价涨7%以上也说明市场在重新定价AI叙事溢价。对0700.HK的covered call策略建议上调心理止盈区间。延续报道：AI model及股价反应均为9月22日事件，持续关注后续产品进展。

title: 小米发布Xiaomi 18 Pro系列：售价5999元起 首发高通2nm双旗舰平台、徕卡双两亿影像
summary: 9月23日，小米正式发布Xiaomi 18 Pro与18 Pro Max，搭载高通2纳米旗舰芯片（双平台），配备徕卡双2亿像素摄像头，最大8500mAh电池，从5999元起售；18 Pro Max从6999元起售。公司确认Pro系列年内推出全球版本。
why: 新旗舰定价提升且首发全球版说明小米高端化策略持续推进；旗舰提价可能改善ASP，对1810.HK的sell put策略建议维持行权价不超过近月低点区间。延续报道：产品9月23日首发，全球上市及销售数据仍在持续追踪。
